text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Tomorrow is the Satsuki Sho, Satono
Diamond's
long-awaited first G1 race.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Yes, it's in my bag. I even remembered
to pack a
spare pair of shoes.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Yes. I've also made sure they're properly

attached.
...Trainer, please try to relax.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I wanted to help her relax, but she ends
up
comforting me instead.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Bzzzzzt!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
I'm getting a call. Please excuse me for a
moment.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Hello? Father? Yes, I'm doing well.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Sorry about that.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
That's right. ...Hehehe! Father was
checking to see
if I forgot anything, just
like you.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
It's always everyone else that gets
nervous before
I race.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
I told him I'm definitely going to win, but
he still
just told me to be careful not to
get injured.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
You might be right. My parents have
never once
told me to win. They've
always been so gentle
with me.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
And that's precisely why I want to win
tomorrow's
race.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
I aspire to become an illustrious runner
and to
bring honor to my parents by
being the first to
realize our family's
dream.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Despite being so busy, both Mother and
Father
have always dedicated
themselves to supporting
the
Umamusume world.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
I'd like to reward them for all their hard
work! ♪

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Indeed! I'll gift them with the Satono
family's first
G1 victory!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She's renewed her determination to win
the
Satsuki Sho. I'm looking forward her
first G1
victory.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Yet, as if to put a damper on the
moment, the TV
weather forecast
delivers some unfortunate news.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
It does seem that way. But don't worry! I
have a
strategy to deal with poor track
conditions!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Satono Diamond responds with
reassuring
composure. Still, to be on the
safe side, we
decide to leave the
academy early tomorrow.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
There's not much rain the following
morning, but
the strong winds are
relentless and show no signs
of letting
up.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The strong winds are likely to cause the
trains to
stop running. With that in mind,
we decide to
take a taxi to Nakayama
Racecourse.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
However, the weather has also backed
up traffic
considerably. I was planning to
be at the
racecourse by now, but we still
haven't gotten off
the highway.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
When we make it off the highway, the
regular
roads are also backed up. At this
rate, we're not
going to make it in time!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Okay! I'll see you there!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Ngh! The wind is so strong!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She gets knocked back by the gusts.
Spring
storms are rare this time of year.
For one to delay
us in traffic like this, it's
almost as if...

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
(An unusual storm and heavy traffic...
Why does
everything have to go wrong
today of all days?)

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: (Could this be... the jinx?)

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
(At this rate, I might not make it in time
for the
race at all. And even if I do, I
won't be able to run
well with these
frazzled nerves!)

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
(Could the jinx be trying to stop me
from
achieving greatness?!)

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
(...!
I'm not going to let that happen!)

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: HAAAAAH!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Satono Diamond lets out a fierce cry and
tears off
down the exclusive
Umamusume lane.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I arrive at Nakayama Racecourse thirty
minutes
before the Satsuki Sho is
scheduled to start.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I head for the paddock, praying she
made it on
time.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I look around for her, and...

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Phew...

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Oh! Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Yes! I made it just in the nick of time!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
The weather has thrown me for a little
bit of a
loop, but I think that actually
helped me stay
calm!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Satono Diamond grins in an incredible
display of
mental fortitude.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
This is the first race of the Classic Triple
Crown... I
absolutely can't afford to lose
here!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
As if summoned by her determination,
the sun
makes a dazzling entrance,
banishing the storm
clouds.
